role: XCUITest coverage of the Flo (AI assistant) tab: first-run disclosure, input surfaces (composer/prefab chips/setup), prefab question text, and no blocking alert without API keys.

flags.text: Passes the bare '-UITests' launch argument, which no production code reads (only -UITests-FreshInstall at AppLaunchRecovery.swift:185 and -UITests-ForcePaywall/-UITests-SeedArchive at UITestLaunchArguments.swift:18,23 are checked); it is inert
Class doc lists empty-state copy and prefab chips being tappable as tested; no test asserts empty-state copy or taps a chip

units.does: Sets continueAfterFailure=false, creates XCUIApplication, appends launch arguments -UITests, -UITests-FreshInstall and English locale (UITestLanguage.english), launches the app (the app wipes onboarding/disclaimer/paywall flags, settings files and the session archive via AppLaunchRecovery.resetUITestStateIfRequested) and walks every first-run gate with UITestLaunch.toMainUI, ignoring its Bool result.
units.entry: XCTest runner: setUp before each test in the class

units.does: Releases the XCUIApplication (app = nil); does not terminate the app.
units.entry: XCTest runner: tearDown after each test in the class

units.does: Selects the Flo tab via UITestNav.selectTab; throws XCTSkip when it fails.

branches.effect: throw XCTSkip (test reported as skipped, not failed)

flags.text: Every navigation failure to Flo, including a regression, is reported as a skip; UITestNav's own doc (EmuquUITests.swift:377-380) describes this as how a whole class skips without exercising anything

units.does: Opens Flo, accepts the disclosure if present (result ignored), and asserts a composer, prefab chips or assistant.setup screen appears within 16s.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: Named testFirstOpenPresentsDisclaimer but never asserts the disclosure appeared: acceptAssistantDisclaimer's Bool is discarded, so a build that dropped the disclosure passes

units.does: Opens Flo, accepts disclosure; returns (passes) if assistant.setup appears; otherwise asserts assistant.prefabChips and a 'How am I doing today' button/text exist.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: On a simulator with no on-device model the test returns before any assertion and reports pass

units.does: Opens Flo; if a button labelled 'Got it' or 'Accept' appears taps it, then asserts no alert appears within 4s.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: tap() it (no scroll, no hittability check); else proceed

flags.text: Uses an English label predicate and plain tap() instead of acceptAssistantDisclaimer, which the harness says is needed because the accept button sits below the fold (EmuquUITests.swift:309-313); then asserts only absence of an alert, so it passes with the disclosure sheet still blocking chat and never checks the user can type as its doc claims

The predicate 'Got it'/'Accept' never matches the Flo disclosure's accept button, whose label is 'I understand — continue' (DisclaimerSheet.swift:103), so this test never dismisses the disclosure and only asserts no alert exists while the sheet is still up; the class doc (lines 53-54) names the same non-existent CTA labels
